positions.why: NuScale: the ONLY NRC-certified SMR design, under $10 after an earnings miss while capital chases unapproved pre-revenue names. If the power gap forces a bid for anything permitted, certification is the scarce asset.
Nano Nuclear: smallest cap, microreactors aimed at behind-the-meter data centre load — the highest-beta expression of the same shortage. Sized as a lottery ticket, not a position.
GE Vernova: gas turbines and grid equipment are what actually delivers power on the BINDING 2026-27 timeline, with sold-out order books. Funds the thesis if the SMR leg stays dead money.
Quanta: builds the interconnection itself. Whoever wins the generation argument, the wires still have to be strung — the least-conditional way to be long the bottleneck.
